report.executiveSummary: During the incident window, Contoso Retail customers experienced degraded checkout and product catalogue performance (p99: 1100ms). Investigation evidence indicates the root cause is application-side, specifically: Client-side p99 latency: 1100ms vs server-side Cosmos latency: 16ms — 1084ms gap indicates client/SDK or host overhead; Cosmos DB 429 RateLimitExceeded: 12 in last 5 min on products container; Large document writes: ~52KB documents (recommended <1KB for typical catalogue items). Azure Cosmos DB service-side health remained nominal (server-side latency: 16ms). Azure SQL Database remained healthy. Immediate corrective actions are identified and safe to execute without service escalation.
report.engineeringRca: Telemetry shows p99 latency at 1100ms with 12 Cosmos 429 events, 900 RU/min consumption, host CPU 28%, and SQL latency 58ms. The active toggles (largeDocument) directly align with the observed failure signature. The client-to-server latency delta of 1084ms indicates most latency is introduced in the application, SDK, query design, or host execution path rather than inside the Azure Cosmos DB service plane.
